articles.title: ‘Living in jail at home for 6 yrs, no social life, no job’: Hathras rape victim’s family
articles.description: The Hathras victim's family lives under constant security, feeling like they are under house arrest.  They have faced severe financial distress and isolation for six years.  The Allahabad High Court ordered their relocation to Noida or Ghaziabad within three months.  This move offers hope for better job opportunities and education for the family.  The family cherishes a Tulsi plant planted by the victim as a last memory.

articles.title: Moody’s economist Mark Zandi warns: ‘We got a problem’
articles.description: Mark Zandi, chief economist at Moody's Analytics, foresees a looming economic crisis as the U.S. surpasses a 100% debt-to-GDP ratio. With a staggering annual budget deficit of two trillion dollars and national debt exceeding forty trillion, investor confidence is dwindling. Compounding these issues are rising interest rates and turmoil in the bond market, raising urgent fiscal red flags.

articles.title: School holiday August 28, 2026: Check state-wise closure updates amid rain and Raksha Bandhan
articles.description: School holiday August 28: Schools across India are not uniformly closed on August 28, 2026. The day coincides with Raksha Bandhan, while the IMD has forecast heavy or very heavy rainfall in several regions. Odisha, parts of Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Sikkim face weather warnings, while Delhi and Haryana have no IMD rain warning for August 28 in the latest subdivision bulletin. School closures will depend on state, district or school-level orders, so students should check official local notifications before travelling.

articles.title: RRB NTPC Graduate CBT 2 Result 2026 declared for CEN 06/2025; download here
articles.description: RRB NTPC Graduate CBT 2 Result 2026: RRB has declared the NTPC Graduate CBT 2 Result 2026 under CEN 06/2025 on August 27 at 5 pm. The CBT-2 examination was held on July 10 for recruitment to 5,810 graduate-level vacancies. Candidates can check regional merit list PDFs and their individual scorecards through the respective RRB portals. Shortlisted candidates will proceed to CBAT or CBTST, depending on the post. The next-stage examinations are tentatively scheduled for September 2026, followed by document verification in December.

articles.title: ₹23 lakh salary, just ₹15,000 expenses: Why this 27-year-old PSU employee says government jobs beat private careers
articles.description: A 27-year-old PSU employee’s Reddit post has reignited India’s enduring fascination with government jobs, claiming his ₹23 lakh package and extensive workplace benefits allow him to save nearly his entire salary. Yet his low-cost life comes with remote postings, limited social opportunities and professional monotony, raising a larger question: does financial security alone guarantee a fulfilling career and life?

articles.title: Who was Ankit Baliyan?
articles.description: Haryanvi singer Ankit Baliyan was shot dead outside a Shamli gym on August 26, 2026. Assailants on motorcycles reportedly fired approximately eighteen rounds at the popular artist. Baliyan, known for his energetic Haryanvi music, had a significant YouTube following. His popular songs included 'Bhari Court Mein Goli Marenge' and '112 NE'. Police are investigating the incident and seeking to identify the attackers.
